clues: This town sits in the north east corner of Jalisco state in Mexico. It lies in a high land called Los Altos, in the middle of the country.
Winters here are quite cold, while summers are hot and rainy. Dry lands lie to the north, and richer green lands lie to the south.
The town was first founded in the fifteen hundreds, long ago. Churches from that same time still stand in its centre today, old and proud.
A saint named Toribio Romo was born in this town. His birth here makes the town a stop for faith trips from far away.
Faith trips to Santa Ana de Guadalupe have made this town well known. Many visitors come here for that one holy place.
